title: SAMPLE: Mellitah loading window reported, not independently confirmed
summary: A company circular described as an operational notice said a limited loading window was available at Mellitah. This sample item exists to show how an oil-sector update should be labelled.
whatHappened: According to a document described as a company operations note, Mellitah was said to have a short loading window on 3 September 2026. Libya Global Reports has not seen a matching National Oil Corporation statement and has not corroborated berth status on site.
whyItMatters: Western export points affect liftings, shipping schedules and related logistics. Treating an uncorroborated circular as a confirmed reopening would overstate what is known.
watchNext: A named NOC or operator confirmation, or a clear contradiction from a second independent source. Watch whether the claimed window is described as completed, extended or cancelled.
confidenceRationale: Single attributed document, no second source, no official confirmation.
